PERSONAL: a faint show-through from another sheet (not among these scans) is visible in the right half — a numbered list that looks like his own bus-trip log: e.g. '18 → 22 → 22 → 32 (Bc)', '9 → 2 → 9 (D)', '3) Hama? → Khâm Thiên → Hama?', '6) Trường PĐP → SVĐ QG' (probably Trường Phan Đình Phùng → SVĐ Quốc gia), '8) BX Giáp Bát → Nam Thăng Long', '21 → 26 → 28 → 30 → 7', '32 → 22 → 15 → 15 → 56 → 53 → 35 → 26 → 28', '10) Hà Đông → ?', '39 → 53 …', '11) BX Gia Lâm → Ngã Tư Sở'. Only partially readable through the paper; the real page should be scanned separately if it exists.

tickets.details: Pink single-trip ticket 'VÉ XE BUÝT LƯỢT', TRAMOC logo, Trung tâm Quản lý và Điều hành Giao thông Đô thị Hà Nội (16 Cao Bá Quát, Ba Đình), 'Liên 2: Giao cho khách hàng', Tuyến 09, 5.000 đ/lượt, vé có bảo hiểm, Mẫu số 01VEDB2/001, Ký hiệu RM/12P, Nº 0139753 — a newer ticket design than the 2005 ones (route 09 was 3000đ in the notebook). Under it a white ticket is partly visible; its route number is hidden. Same purple pencil tin as the other two photos (lid printed with a Chinese multiplication table and units; inner tray with a 'BOY / Plugged Boy / Lovely Stars' cartoon).

Two stacks of pink 'VÉ XE BUÝT (Giao cho khách hàng)' tickets, Mã số thuế 0100778682-1. Tuyến 38: 3.000 đ/lượt, Ký hiệu BS/2005T, Nº 0003432 (a small blue ink mark beside 'VÉ'). Tuyến 32: 3.000 đ/lượt, Ký hiệu BL/2005T, Nº 3740434. Footer: 'Được phép sử dụng theo công văn số 2361/CT-AC ngày 18 tháng 3 năm 2005 của Cục thuế TP Hà Nội'. Many more tickets under the top ones (route numbers hidden).

Tuyến 15: green ticket, 5.000 đ/lượt, Ký hiệu YA/2005T, Nº 1379732 (matches the notebook's 5000đ fare for route 15 Long Biên – Phố Nỉ). Tuyến 25: white ticket, 3.000 đ/lượt, Ký hiệu XB/2005T, Nº 0079752. Same 2005 tax-office authorisation footer. Pink tickets stacked underneath.

summary: Hand-copied Hà Nội bus route notebook (18 scans, scan2000 116–133) in a 'HẢI TIẾN' ruled notebook. Scans 116–130 are a 4-column table with one entry per route in number order 01–56: route number (circled) + terminals; fare, first/last bus (often per terminal) and headways CĐ/BT/TĐ (peak/normal/off-peak); full street list outbound then return; vehicle model (older model names like 'Daewoo I/II/III', 'Transinco I/II/III', 'Hyundai', 'Chorus' struck and replaced by model codes BS105/BS090/BS090DL/B80/B30), seats, HĐ = buses running/total fleet, and trips per day. Route 49 was skipped and route 52 is missing in the table; both were added later on scan 131. The table pages carry no date; they match the network 'thực hiện từ 2/2005' (printed sheet IMG_2315) and the 2005 tickets. Dated notes start on scan 131: '1-10-2006' (adjustments of routes 25, 40, 56 and new route 52) and '1-3-2007' (new route 49, then 11 adjustments on scans 132–133: 03, 34, 11, 40, 52, 05, 39, 08, 36, 31, 23 — mainly via Cầu Chương Dương, city terminals moved to CV Thống Nhất, Long Biên terminals moved to Yên Phụ via Hàng Than). Fares: 3000đ standard; 5000đ for 07 (Nội Bài), 15 (Phố Nỉ), 17 (Nội Bài), 54 (Bắc Ninh); 4000đ for 56. Routes 41–45 (Bachabus) have the fare/hours column left blank. JSON has 70 route entries: 56 full routes + 14 adjustment entries (the adjustment entries use '…' for unchanged sections, as he wrote them). No ticks, ride marks or comments inside the route table; the only personal trace is a faint show-through on scan 132 of another sheet that looks like his own numbered trip log (chains of route numbers, e.g. '6) Trường PĐP → SVĐ QG', '32 → 22 → 15 → 15 → 56 → 53 → 35 → 26 → 28'). Tickets in a pencil tin: routes 09 (5.000đ, newer design RM/12P), 38 and 32 (3.000đ), 15 (5.000đ) and 25 (3.000đ), all 2005-series except 09.
